title: Taarikh
overview: Durlov Dutta, aged 70, shares the company of loneliness in life's twilight, yet his psyche diverges from the norm. In 2008, an irreversible incident shattered his mental equilibrium, leaving him stranded in time as fate snatched his loved ones away. While the world surged forward, he remained stagnant. Enter Anuran Hazarika, a journalist, who vows to liberate Durlov from his anguish. Can Anuran's efforts dissolve the shadows haunting Durlov's existence, restoring color to his life?
